result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: the action button in the top-right header is missing its icon.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner (next to the delivery address) has a red notification badge dot, but its main icon (such as a notification bell or cart icon) is missing, leaving an empty gray circle.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the SVG or icon asset for the top-right header button loads and renders properly inside the circular container.
